payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: April, Jung, Kelle, Linnea, Nickole, Tawna

Planning (April): I’m strongest in security; lowest cost for me is ISSUE-0002::review (cost=1.08, effort=1.0, low priority). To avoid duplicates, I can take ISSUE-0002::review unless someone already claims it. I can also take a low-effort security task like ISSUE-0001::triage (effort 2.8, cost 2.66) if frontend subtasks are covered.
If you’re planning to take any ISSUE-0002 subtasks: please confirm. My goal is to maximize total tasks without overlapping, staying within 10h availability.

Planning (Kelle): I’ll focus on security tasks. My cheapest feasible claim is ISSUE-0001::triage (effort 2.8, cost 3.45). I will avoid claiming ISSUE-0002 frontend tasks to prevent duplicates with others.
